style_anchor: Dungeon Meshi whimsical fantasy ecosystem art style, warm golden sunlight with deep teal-green shadows, bioluminescent blue-green glow, delicate vine scrollwork and organic natural motifs, soft naturalistic rendering, satin-metallic UI texture, full-bleed borderless game UI

layers.name: 背景层
layers.description: 完整场景背景：古老石塔废墟、巨树根系、绳索桥、树冠、阳光穿透、地面苔藓荧光、野花
layers.prompt_hint: Full-bleed borderless fantasy RPG login screen background, ancient stone tower ruin wrapped by giant tree roots, rope suspension bridges, thick canopy, golden sunbeams, bioluminescent moss, wildflowers, deep layered dungeon perspective
